jobs.title: Genesis-World: Core Simulation Engine Engineer
jobs.description_excerpt: WHAT WE’RE BUILDING Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future. Genesis-World https://github.com/Genesis-Embodied-AI/genesis-world is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI https://www.genesis.ai/.
